remarks: What a charmer! A remarkable find in New Canaan! Move right into this 1927 antique with covered front porch and stone fireplace. Three bedrooms and two full baths. Lovely 1.16 acre property with sweeping back yard, mature trees and landscaping. There is a separate barn garage with additional storage. Plenty of room for expansion. Automatic generator. Conveniently located just one short mile to the town center, express train to NYC, schools, parks, shops & restaurants. A wonderful place to call home.
